info.name: ControlOps Mobile — Staff / Client / Admin
info.description:
Mobile app API collection for Staff, Client, and Admin modules.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `https://controlops.co.uk/api`)

**Auth:** Bearer JWT from Auth → Login (token auto-saved).

Status tags:
- *(live)* — implemented on current backend
- *(planned)* — required by mobile spec; contract for app/backend

### Permission codes
| Code | Used by |
|------|--------|
| `portal.sites.read` | Staff, Client |
| `portal.rota.current` | Staff, Client |
| `portal.rota.upcoming` | Staff |
| `portal.rota.previous` | Staff |
| `portal.hours.read` | Staff, Client |
| `attend.read` / `attend.write` | Staff clock / attendance |
| `assign.read` / `assign.write` | OT / early finish |
| `staff_req.read` / `staff_req.write` | Client staff requests |
| `staff_req.review` | Admin/Controller approve/decline |
| `inv.read` | Client invoices |
| `portal.incident.write` *(planned)* | Staff/Client incidents |
| `portal.attendance.clock` *(planned)* | GPS clock in/out |
| `portal.invoice.query` *(planned)* | Client invoice comments |
| `staff_req.standdown` *(planned)* | Client cancel before approval |
